author_report.accepted: At this first follow-up the author confirmed the rest of the tests and left two repairs for recheck. Both were subsequently accepted on 2026-10-01; see author_recheck below.

fixes.ground: Partition the original 60000-MU-wide exterior into nine bounded native regions. Preserve its height, grass, light, horizon extent and blocking; alter only the original four horizon-line endpoints and four front-sector references. All other original map records remain unchanged.
fixes.roof: Opaque 128-by-8-MU gable follows the native paired roof undersides above door group 915, from ceiling slab top Z=400 to ridge Z=456. Existing CMEX01 material; no new collision.

diagnosis.ground: Reproduced in both the initial issue map and preserved 4.36.28 baseline. Removing Line_Horizon, lowering the sky ceiling and splitting only outer boundary lines did not fix it. An isolated bounded sector and the final nine-region partition rendered grass. Exact internal renderer cause remains unidentified.
diagnosis.roof: The original gable fills wall-tagged sectors; the upper door shares the interior sectors, leaving that front strip uncovered. A copied Prueba save established the view. The author's original save was not modified or committed.

native.engine: GZDoom 4.14.2, Windows 11, Vulkan, RTX 3070 Ti, development Doom II IWAD, no autoload
native.visual: Reported ground point, all eight exterior floor regions plus central exterior, and upper door from both sides closed/open

native.fixture_notes: The initial multi-line exterior tour did not preserve wait ordering; final chained per-view exec files do. The first 140-tic open-door capture occurred after native automatic closure; final roof views use 24 tics after Use. Preliminary local captures are not final visual evidence.

reproduction: From repository root run python assets/generators/validate_map01_exterior.py, python validate_project.py and python assets/validation_4370/issue61_determinism.py; build normally.
Copy followup/native to build/issue61_qa. Run python assets/validation_4370/followup/issue61_prepare_followup.py to generate the nine-point chained exterior tour.

Use assets/validation_4370/run_issue61.ps1 -Package -Label <label> -Wait -Commands (Get-Content assets/validation_4370/followup/<label>.cfg -Raw) for followup_checks, followup_roof_views and followup_bounds_final. The local launcher requires a licensed engine/IWAD installation and build/gzdoom.ini.
The saved camera is reproduced in Followup.zs on a fresh MAP01. No author save, IWAD, executable or personal config is packaged.
